title: Mindrolling Monastery Dehradun - Tibetan Culture & Travel Guide
content:
Mindrolling Monastery - Dehradun,

Mindrolling Monastery, located in Clement Town, Dehradun, is one of the most important Tibetan monasteries in India. The name “Mindrolling” means Place of Perfect Emancipation. The monastery was originally founded in Tibet in 1676, but after Tibet’s troubles, it was re-established in India in 1965 by Khochhen Rinpoche and a group of monks.

Today, it is not only a tourist attraction but also a major center for Buddhist studies, meditation, and cultural learning. The monastery has a peaceful campus with gardens, prayer halls, and a huge stupa.

The main highlights are:

The Great Stupa - 60 meters tall, one of the largest in Asia.

A 35-meter tall statue of Lord Buddha in golden color.

Beautiful wall paintings that tell stories from Buddhist teachings.

A large prayer hall with tall pillars and colorful artwork.

The monastery also has schools for monks, research centers, and areas where visitors can sit quietly and meditate. For many, it feels like stepping into a piece of Tibet in India.

Best Time to Visit Mindrolling Monastery:

  • Peak Season (October - March): Weather is cool and clear, 8°C – 20°C. Best for walking around the gardens and enjoying the stupa.
  • Moderate Season (April - June): Warm and sunny, 20°C – 32°C. Suitable for sightseeing, but afternoons can be hot. Morning and evening are more pleasant.
  • Low Season (July - September):Rainy season, 18°C – 26°C. The monastery looks green and fresh, but heavy rains may affect outdoor walking.

Timings & Entry Fee: Opening Hours: 9:00 AM - 7:00 PM (all days), Entry Fee: Free for everyone.

How to Reach Mindrolling Monastery:

  • By Road: Around 10 km from Dehradun Clock Tower. Easily reachable by taxi, auto, or bus.
  • By Train: Nearest station is Dehradun Railway Station (9 km).
  • By Air: Nearest airport is Jolly Grant Airport (31 km).

Best Places to Visit Near Mindrolling Monastery (within 50 km):

1- Robber’s Cave (8 km): Natural cave with a stream inside.

2- Sahastradhara (14 km): Famous for waterfalls and sulphur springs.

3- Tapkeshwar Temple (11 km): Shiva temple inside a natural cave.

4- Forest Research Institute (8 km): Beautiful colonial campus with museums.

5- Malsi Deer Park (13 km): Small zoo and picnic area for families.

6- Shikhar Falls (15 km): A hidden waterfall, perfect for a short trek.

7- Lachhiwala Nature Park (22 km): Picnic spot with water pools in forest.

8- Mussoorie (35 km): Popular hill station with viewpoints and Kempty Falls.

9- Clock Tower (9 km): Iconic landmark of Dehradun city.

10- Kalsi (43 km): Historic place with Ashoka’s ancient rock edict.
excerpt: Mindrolling Monastery in Dehradun is one of the largest Tibetan monasteries in India. With its tall golden stupa, giant Buddha statues, peaceful gardens, and rich Tibetan culture, it is a perfect place for peace seekers and travelers.
